characters.name: Wraith
characters.prompt: High-quality anime film still, modern Japanese action RPG look inspired by Zenless Zone Zero: thin clean line art, detailed anime illustration, flat two-tone cel shading, soft rim light, vivid color grading, smooth camera motion, 16:9, consistent character design. Character reference sheet, full-body standing pose, facing the camera directly, whole body visible from head to feet, human height with a slim agile swordsman build, NOT a giant, even soft lighting, plain flat light grey studio background, nothing else in the frame, still camera. Character: the Demon Swordsman Wraith, an undead knight in ornate gothic plate armour of dark gunmetal steel with gold filigree trim, a horned closed helm with an empty black visor slit, a crown of magenta ghost fire burning above the helm, glowing magenta runes on the breastplate, a tattered cape of dark violet mist trailing in strips, a slender longsword glowing magenta held point-down in the right hand, a wisp of magenta ghost fire hovering over the open left gauntlet.
